description: Defines the sib1_scheduler class responsible for scheduling SIB1 in a 5G NR scheduler, including methods for running slot scheduling, updating SIB1 PDU, and filling grants. Contains private members for configuration, logging, and scheduling parameters.

classes.name: sib1_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling SIB1 messages in the 5G NR scheduler, managing grants, updates, and resource allocation.

methods.name: sib1_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with configuration, resource allocator, and payload size.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SIB1 grants for a given slot.

methods.name: handle_sib1_update_indication
methods.description: Updates the SIB1 PDU version and size.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler when the cell is deactivated.

methods.name: allocate_sib1
methods.description: Searches for space in PDSCH and PDCCH for SIB1 and its DCI.

methods.name: fill_sib1_grant
methods.description: Fills resource grid with SIB1 slots based on grants and DMRS info.

methods.name: handle_pending_sib1_update
methods.description: Handles pending updates to the SIB1 PDU.
